Punjab SGPC passes resolution against CM Mann over video row

The Shiromani Gurdwara Parbandhak Committee (SGPC) has passed a resolution calling for an FIR against Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann. This action stems from a video row involving the Chief Minister. Posters urging a boycott of CM Mann have also appeared across the state.
